title: 第25章 装逼冲锋海上决战第26章 暗影阴谋升级
lines: 银蓝潮纹从他掌心绕开，蓝金星火贴着指骨一圈圈压低。
星光潜航器刚冲出海雾，船身还挂着海底宫殿崩塌留下的裂痕。两枚压舱环灭了，舱尾铁板翻起，星纹蒸汽核心只剩半数刻度。卡洛琳一脚踩住操舵台下方的铜阀，另一只手拍在报警晶上。
“别叫了！我知道要死！你再叫，我先拆你！”
报警晶闪了两下，熄了。
洛晖回头竖起拇指。
“赛汀维修术，主打恐吓设备。”
卡洛琳咬住铜针。
“你再贫，下一炮我把你弹出去堵炮口。”
海面外侧，赤金商会舰队排成半月形。外层装甲护卫舰横开星纹挡板，中层锁链船垂下赤金铁钩，内层三艘炼金炮舰高塔亮起。主舰塔楼上，赤金狐纹旗被风暴扯直。
海面浮着细碎银光。
绮兰展开仓单，指尖飞快点过两行。
“深海星盐。马尔契买的那批，全撒在海面了。潮汐星纹一动，就会留下轨迹。”
绮雯半跪在舱门影缝旁，暗影鳞片贴上海水反光处。
“下面还有星纹锚链。压住浪向，封死下潜路。锚链末端也涂了盐。”
卡洛琳盯着航行盘。
“所以，往下死，往前死，原地等死。三选一，我建议选听起来贵点的。”
洛晖看向主舰高塔。
“往前。”
卡洛琳转头。
“我刚才没骂清楚？”
“骂得挺准。”洛晖把掌心贴上舷窗，“但老狐狸花这么多盐，总不能让他白腌。”
主舰塔楼上，哈曼站在赤金主镜前。黑色舰长大衣外扣着商会铜章，腰侧挂着炼金短枪。他抬手，扩音晶阵再次亮起。
“洛晖，你私取海域星痕，破坏赤金商会星痕流通契约。按五城航道条例，商会有权追索非法资源。”
洛晖按下舱内传声阵。
“奥尔山抢输了，海底又来补账。你们商会脸皮用深海星盐腌过吧？防潮还防羞。”
几艘护卫舰甲板上，雇佣兵动作停了一下。远处赛汀灯塔附近，几艘自由船的灯帆晃动。
哈曼的手按上主镜边缘。
“交出第四枚星痕，奥尔山完整星痕，海底宫殿坐标。否则击沉潜航器，残骸由商会打捞。”
绮兰把奥尔山停战协议副本拍进契约镜面。
“他违反停战协议，还避开曜都审查，选赛汀灰色航道截杀。若我们沉了，他会写成海底节点反噬事故。若我们反击，他会写成洛晖攻击贸易舰队。”
洛晖勾了勾手指。
“那就让他连笔都握不稳。”
绮兰把裂开的银色钥片按进能源槽。
“我能稳住护膜一次。只一次。”
绮雯抬起暗影之刃。
“我能切断尾部追踪符，再做三道假潮痕。”
卡洛琳推开红色铜杆。
content_en:
Silver-blue tide lines circled around his palm, and blue-gold sparks pressed down against his finger bones.
The starlight submersible had just broken out of the sea fog, and the hull still bore the cracks left by the collapse of the underwater palace. The two ballast rings were destroyed, the stern iron plate flipped up, and only half of the star-patterned steam core remained. Caroline stepped on the copper valve under the steering console with one foot and patted the alarm crystal with her other hand.
"Stop screaming! I know I'm going to die! If you scream again, I'll kill you first!"
The alarm crystal flashed twice and then went out.
Luo Hui turned around and gave a thumbs up.
"Setin Repair Technique, focusing on intimidation devices."
Caroline bit the copper pin.
"No matter how poor you are, I will pop you out to block the muzzle of the next shot."
On the outside of the sea, the Red Gold Chamber of Commerce fleet was arranged in a half-moon shape. The outer armored frigate opened its star-patterned baffles, the middle chain ship lowered its red gold iron hook, and the towers of the three inner alchemy gunboats lit up. On the main ship tower, the red gold fox pattern flag was torn straight by the storm.
Fragments of silver light floated on the surface of the sea.
Qilan unfolded the warehouse receipt and quickly clicked on two lines with her fingertips.
"Deep sea star salt. The batch that Marchi bought was all scattered on the sea. When the tidal star pattern moves, it will leave a trail."
Qiwen half-knelt beside the hatch of the cabin door, her shadow scales sticking to the reflection of the sea water.
"There is also a star-patterned anchor chain below. It suppresses the wave direction and seals the dive route. The end of the anchor chain is also coated with salt."
Caroline stared at the navigation plate.
"So, die down, die forward, and wait there to die. Choose one of the three, and I suggest choosing the one that sounds more expensive."
Luo Hui looked at the main ship tower.
"Move forward."
Caroline turned her head.
"Didn't I curse clearly just now?"
"The scolding is quite accurate." Luo Hui put his palm against the porthole, "But the old fox spent so much salt, we can't let him salt it in vain."
On the main ship tower, Haman stood in front of the red gold main mirror. The captain's black coat has a bronze medal of the Chamber of Commerce buckled on the outside, and an alchemy short gun hangs on his waist. He raised his hand, and the loudspeaker array lit up again.
"Luo Hui, you privately stole the sea star marks and destroyed the star mark circulation contract of the Red Gold Chamber of Commerce. According to the Five Cities Waterway Regulations, the Chamber of Commerce has the right to pursue illegal resources."
Luo Hui pressed the sound transmission array in the cabin.
"Olshan lost the fight, and the bottom of the sea came to make up for it. Your chamber of commerce has had its face salted with deep sea star salt, right? It's moisture-proof and shame-proof."
On the decks of several frigates, the mercenaries stopped for a moment. In the distance, near the Setin Lighthouse, the sails of several free ships swayed.
Haman pressed his hand against the edge of the main mirror.
"Hand over the fourth star mark, the complete star mark of Olshan, and the coordinates of the underwater palace. Otherwise, the submarine will be sunk and the wreckage will be salvaged by the Chamber of Commerce."
Qilan photographed a copy of the Olshan Armistice Agreement into the contract mirror.
"He violated the armistice agreement, avoided Yaodu's review, and chose the Saiting Gray Channel to intercept and kill us. If we sank, he would write it as a submarine node backlash accident. If we counterattack, he would write it as Luo Hui's attack on the trade fleet."
Luo Hui curled his fingers.
"Then he can't even hold a pen steady."
Qilan pressed the cracked silver key into the energy slot.
"I can hold the membrane steady once. Just once."
Qiwen raised the Shadow Blade.
"I can cut off the tail tracking charm and make three fake tide marks."
Caroline pushed away the red brass pole.
title_en: Chapter 25 Pretending to charge to the decisive battle at sea Chapter 26 The shadow conspiracy escalates
